title: You Don't Need Cash in China: Foreign Cards Now Spend $50,000 a Year | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone still tells you to bring a stack of cash to China. In 2026, you might not touch a single banknote.

Alipay and WeChat Pay now let overseas visitors link an eligible foreign Visa or Mastercard — no mainland Chinese bank account required. Once it's linked you just scan the QR code that's on every counter, stall and taxi. Official limits for linked international cards run up to about $5,000 per transaction and $50,000 per year, which covers almost any trip. Cash is still legal tender and refusing it is restricted by regulation, but in big cities you can genuinely go days on your phone alone.

🧭 Expert Tip: set up Alipay or WeChat Pay and verify your foreign card while you're still home on good WiFi — activation can take a day, and you don't want to be doing it at the airport.
